description: Edits the settings; fields left out keep their value. settings: { profile?, b2c_policy_claim? (tfp or acr), validate_client_secrets?, token_lifetime_minutes?, token_shape?: { scope_claim_name?, scope_claim_format?, roles_claim_name?, roles_nested_key?, access_token_audience? } }.

configuration_id.description: The configuration id (from create_tenant or get_tenant).

settings.description: The settings to change. The configuration's settings. Fields left out keep their value.

b2c_policy_claim.description: AzureAdB2C policy claim: tfp (default) or acr (legacy). An omitted field preserves the stored setting, including across profile switches.

token_shape.description: Claim shape options (Generic profile only); fields left out keep their value.

access_token_audience.description: Whether the audience is sent as aud (default) or as client_id with no aud (like Cognito); Generic profile only, see the audience rule.

roles_claim_name.description: Where roles are emitted, e.g. realm_access; roles when not set.

roles_nested_key.description: Nests roles under this key of roles_claim_name, e.g. roles for realm_access.roles.

validate_client_secrets.description: Require client secrets at the token endpoint.

name: edit_settings
